sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which adverb correctly completes the sentence? The old man walked ___ across the busy street.
Choose the correct preposition: The frightened little cat hid ___ the bed during the loud thunderstorm.
Fill in the blank with the correct conjunction: I wanted to buy the storybook, ___ I did not have enough money in my pocket.
Which interjection best expresses a feeling of sudden pain?
Identify the correct passive voice for the sentence: 'The boy kicked the ball.'
options: A) The ball is kicked by the boy.
B) The ball was kicked by the boy.
C) The ball kicks the boy.
D) The boy was kicking the ball.
questions.answer: B) The ball was kicked by the boy.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct indirect speech for: He said, "I am reading a book."
options: A) He said that he is reading a book.
B) He said that I am reading a book.
C) He said that he was reading a book.
D) He says he was reading a book.
questions.answer: C) He said that he was reading a book.

questions.question_text: What is the correct synonym for the word 'enormous'?
What is the correct antonym for the word 'ancient'?
In the poem 'Vocation', who does the young child see crying out "Bangles, crystal bangles!"?
In the story 'Gilli Danda', the traditional village game is played using objects made of which material?

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: Describe the size and appearance of the water tank mentioned in the story 'What a Tank'. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The tank was incredibly massive and deep, resembling a small natural lake. It had strong, sloping stone walls designed to hold a vast amount of rainwater securely.

questions.question_text: Change this sentence from active to passive voice: 'The talented artist painted a beautiful picture.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A beautiful picture was painted by the talented artist. The focus of the sentence changes from the artist to the beautiful picture that was created.

questions.question_text: Why did the villagers deeply respect the final decision made by the Panchayat? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The villagers deeply respected the Panchayat's decision because they believed that the voice of the Panchayat was the voice of God, representing absolute fairness, justice, and truth.

questions.question_text: Change this direct speech into indirect speech: The teacher said to the students, "The earth is round." [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The teacher told the students that the earth is round. We do not change the tense of the verb here because it states a universal truth.

questions.question_text: Why does the child in the poem 'Vocation' wish to be a watchman walking at night? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The child wants to be a watchman so he can freely walk the dark, lonely streets with a lantern and chase the shadows without anyone scolding him.

questions.question_text: Based on the story 'Gilli Danda', how does the narrator's attitude towards the simple village game change after he returns as an adult? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Returning as a successful adult, the narrator realizes he has lost the true joy and equality of childhood. He sees that his old friend Gaya now plays hesitantly and respectfully with him, showing that social status has ruined the innocent spirit of their favorite game.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are observing the colorful bangle sellers in the chapter 'Glass Bangles'. Describe the variety of bangles they sell and how people react to them. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The sellers display bright, sparkling glass bangles in every color of the rainbow, neatly stacked on their carts. Women and children excitedly gather around, admiring the delicate patterns and listening to the sweet clinking sounds as they happily try on the beautiful ornaments.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Applied Composition

questions.question_text: Write a short, informal letter to your friend congratulating them on winning the first prize in an inter-school debate competition. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Dear Rohan, I was absolutely thrilled to hear that you won the first prize in the inter-school debate competition! Your hard work, confidence, and excellent speaking skills have truly paid off. I am so proud of your amazing achievement. Let us meet soon to celebrate your grand success! Yours lovingly, Amit.

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph describing the importance of honesty and truthfulness in our daily lives. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Honesty is the most valuable quality a person can possess. When we always tell the truth, we build strong trust and deep respect with our family, friends, and teachers. An honest person lives without the fear of being caught in lies. Ultimately, truthfulness brings lasting peace of mind and builds a respectable character.
